title: Crank Position Sensor (CKP)
shortDescription: Suzuki FI code for CKP signal fault.
fullDescription: Suzuki SDS reports C11 when crank sensor signal is missing or weak. Engine no-start common.

fixSteps.title: Inspect CKP
fixSteps.instruction: Locate CKP near front sprocket cover and inspect.

faq.a: Yes, especially on high-mileage gen 2 bikes.

title: Camshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: Suzuki cam sensor circuit fault. Engine may run in batch-fire or fail to start.

title: Intake Air Pressure Sensor
shortDescription: IAP/MAP sensor signal out of range.
fullDescription: Suzuki IAP sensor (MAP) circuit fault. Engine may run rich or lean.

faq.a: Yes especially on older GSX-R series.

title: TPS Throttle Position Sensor
fullDescription: Suzuki TPS fault. Engine may stutter on throttle inputs.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate TPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use SDS tool to set TPS baseline.

fixSteps.title: Replace TPS
fixSteps.instruction: Install new TPS if calibration fails.

faq.a: Yes for proper baseline; aftermarket clones work for many models.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor
fullDescription: Suzuki ECT signal circuit fault. Cold-start fueling may be off.

faq.a: Yes briefly when removing the sensor; have new coolant ready.

title: Intake Air Temp Sensor
fullDescription: Suzuki intake air temperature sensor circuit fault.

faq.a: Slightly; ECU uses default if sensor fails.

title: Tip-Over Sensor
shortDescription: TO sensor circuit fault or activation.
fullDescription: Suzuki tip-over sensor activated or has electrical fault. Bike won't start until reset.

fixSteps.title: Cycle key
fixSteps.instruction: Set bike upright and cycle key off/on.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new TO sensor under tank.

faq.a: Stand upright, cycle key; no scan tool needed.

title: Ignition Coil 1 Fault
fullDescription: Suzuki ECM detects fault on cyl 1 coil. Misfire on cylinder.

fixSteps.title: Swap coils
fixSteps.instruction: Move cyl 1 coil to cyl 2 to isolate.

title: STV Actuator (Secondary Throttle)
fullDescription: Suzuki STV stepper motor or sensor fault on bikes with dual throttle plates.

fixSteps.title: Clean STV
fixSteps.instruction: Remove airbox, clean secondary throttle plates.

fixSteps.title: Replace actuator
fixSteps.instruction: Install new STV stepper motor if needed.

faq.a: Possible with eliminator but voids emissions compliance.

title: Fuel Pump Relay
fullDescription: Suzuki ECM cannot drive fuel pump relay. Pump may not run.

fixSteps.title: Swap relay
fixSteps.instruction: Test by swapping with a known good one.

faq.a: Usually under seat or side cover with other relays.
